title.zh: AstrBot Resource Monitor · 资源下载线路检查与告警插件
title.en: AstrBot Resource Monitor · Resource Line Check & Alert Plugin

summary.zh: 用于 AstrBot 的资源线路定时检查插件，除了看 HTTP 状态码外，还会按清单抽查 Range 分块、文件 MD5 和证书有效期，发现异常时发送消息提醒。
summary.en: AstrBot plugin that periodically checks resource download lines by verifying manifest files, HTTP Range slices, MD5 hashes, and TLS certificates.

zh: 不仅检查 HTTP 200，还会核对清单文件、Range 分块字节与 MD5，用来发现 CDN 返回错误页面或文件截断的情况
发起请求前对域名解析结果做公网地址检查，防止误访问内网地址
支持连续失败确认、重复告警合并、恢复通知与按会话静音
en: Checks manifest files, HTTP Range slices, and MD5 hashes to detect corrupted or truncated CDN responses
Validates resolved IPs against private address ranges before making requests
Includes retry confirmation, alert deduplication, recovery notifications, and per-recipient mute

milestone.zh: 已完成分块校验、内网地址过滤与告警去重逻辑。
milestone.en: Chunk verification, IP filtering, and alert deduplication are complete.
